issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal):boolean, but the provided solution implements addAnimal(Animal) as void. This mismatch between the UML and the solution (and the textual description which does not require a boolean) can confuse students about the expected return type when implementing addAnimal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent: either update the UML in the problem statement to show addAnimal(Animal):void, or change the solution/template to implement addAnimal returning boolean. Prefer updating the UML to void to match the textual description and the solution.

issues.description: The UML and solution define a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal):void, but the template's singFarmSongVerse method currently has no parameter (it is declared as private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)). This mismatched signature in the template can mislead students about the intended helper method and force them to change the signature later.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the template Farm.java so singFarmSongVerse accepts an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) to match the UML and the solution, or clearly document that students should change the signature as part of the implementation.
